grant create on relationships (r:FRIEND_OF) to A;
grant create on nodes (*) to A;
grant create on nodes (e:Document) to B;
grant traverse on nodes (e:Document) to B;
deny traverse on nodes (e:Document) to B;
grant create on relationships (*) to C;
deny traverse on relationships (*) to C;
grant create on nodes (*) where e.level < 5 to C;
grant traverse on nodes (e:Project) to C;
deny traverse on nodes (*) to C;
grant traverse on nodes (e:Employee) where e.salary != 5000 AND e.salary > 5000 to D;
